name: Implicit Arborescence Framing
description: Replaces the explicit algebraic tree conditions (dimension $|S|-1$, cardinality $|S|-1$) with a set of local directed-graph rules (exactly one root, out-degree 1, well-foundedness) framed as software module dependencies. This removes the surface-level formulas that models use to trigger Steiner Tree templates, forcing them to genuinely deduce that the local rules mandate an acyclic connected structure.
